events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine being there: 1969, half a million people, three days of peace and music. Woodstock, a moment in history that still resonates today.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977; he would have been 91.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations and move millions. Long live the King.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996; he would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. His voice, his lyrics, and his legacy continue to echo through music and culture.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970; he would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: Fifty-six years, and still no one plays guitar quite like Jimi Hendrix. A true innovator whose sound changed everything.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Across The Abbey Road
angles.copy: That zebra crossing, that album cover, those songs. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69 and it’s still pure magic.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Sending happy birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and still leading The Pretenders with that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid's another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still an absolute rock 'n' roll star. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: The Device That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember life before? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. Thousands of songs in your pocket!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini to the world's favourite secret agent, celebrating over six decades of espionage and iconic theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember music icon John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius and indelible mark of John Lennon on music and culture.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant, and often very silly, John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of 'The White Album'. The Beatles' sprawling masterpiece still sounds as fresh and innovative as it did in '68.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991; he would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his showmanship, his legacy. Still magnificent.
